title: Byram Hills High School had 6 Black students enrolled in 2025-26
text:
Byram Hills High School had six Black students enrolled for the 2025-26 school year, matching the enrollment from the prior year, according to the New York State Education Department .
The school recorded a total enrollment of 691 students during the 2025-26 school year. Black students made up 0.9% of the overall student population, representing the second smallest ethnic group at the school.
Located within the Byram Hills Central School District with its central office in Armonk, the high school serves local students.
Of the four schools in the district, Byram Hills High School reported the largest number of Black students at that time.
New York ranks second nationally in K-12 public education spending , with an average current expenditure of $30,012 per student. This is nearly twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
